title: fix(widgets): use the available presentation surface after restart
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes conflicting widget instructions after gateway restart recovery: an agent could be told to keep a visualization inline even when the current turn only supported a pinned dashboard widget, then deliver a temporary browser link instead of the intended widget.

## User Impact

Agents receive consistent guidance for the current widget surface and a direct next step for opening a pinned widget's dashboard tab. Existing tool arguments, capability checks, and normal success receipts stay unchanged.

## Why This Change Was Made

Show Widget now describes the same resolved presentation route that execution uses, including channel presenters. Dashboard defers to that placement decision. The shared embedded/Codex prompt, Visualize skill, and docs direct agents to the widget's chat or dashboard surface rather than its internal hosting URL.

## Evidence

- Regression assertions failed on the original guidance and passed after the repair.
- 255 focused tests passed for widget and pinned-only execution, embedded prompts, dashboard operations, and Codex prompts. Channel-presenter and recovered-registration coverage also passed in the broader 287-test run.
- Formatting and `git diff --check` passed; independent Codex review found no actionable issues.
- Initial CI identified one remaining old-description expectation in the tool-registration suite. Updated that assertion; all 54 registration tests, targeted lint, and a fresh independent review passed.
- [Required CI passed](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/34789934444) on `2d95ed37b30693977e828d69fde18a5ee35fc4e2`. Two unchanged transport timing tests passed on failed-jobs-only retry; no transport code or test safeguards were changed.
